notes.title: New Features, Updates & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hi STOL Pilots!

This update includes some fun new features along with several improvements and bug fixes.

[h3]AIRPLANE[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]UPDATE[/b] - Throttle Input - the longer you hold the controller button, the faster RPMs change.  
[*] [b]UPDATE[/b] - External camera HUD - airspeed and altitude text now change color (red, orange) when you get too low or slow in the air, or too fast on the ground.
[/list]

[h3]IMMERSION[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]NEW[/b] - Fishing - a simple fishing system for catching fish that can be cooked and eaten (ongoing WIP).
[*] [b]NEW[/b] - Airplane Winch - a buildable tool for respawning the airplane if you get stuck and need to relocate it within 100'.
[*] [b]NEW[/b] - Pickup Items
[list]
[*] Money - this big stack of bills will be used more in the future, but for now you can use it to fix airplane damage or burn it in a fire (which is kind of what owning/operating an airplane is like IRL). 🙂
[*] Bark Fiber - new building resource pickup item harvested from trees you cut down.  Used to make rope, sleeping bag, etc.
[*] Matchsticks - a new pickup item that is needed to build  campfires.
[/list]
[*] [b]UPDATED [/b] - Campfire - changed the requirements to build a campfire (sticks and matches) and fire is started automatically when first built.
[*] [b]FIXED[/b] -  Tree Harvesting - tree health indicator now decreases when chopping a tree.
[/list]

[h3]PLAYER INVENTORY[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]UPDATED [/b] - Backpack Weight Limit - increased inventory/backpack weight limit to 55lbs.
[*] [b]UPDATED [/b] - Dropping Stacked Items -  now all the individual items in the inventory stack are dropped, instead of single sack.  This helps in situations where you want to split up stacked items.
[*] [b]FIXED[/b] - Backpack Overloading - can no longer add items beyond the weight limit of the backpack/inventory.
[/list]


[h3]TERRAIN & VEGETATION[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]NEW[/b] - Added some new big rocks to test for future update.
[*] [b]NEW[/b] - Added juvenile pine tree to fill in the forest understory more.
[*] [b]UPDATED [/b] - some of the terrain textures and tiling (ongoing WIP).
[*] [b]UPDATED [/b] - more of the vegetation and rock shaders (ongoing WIP)
[*] [b]UPDATED [/b] - the water system in all maps.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch: Improved Airplane Throttle Control
notes.notes: This patch improves airplane throttle control when using a game controller - making it smoother and eliminating a dead zone at the bottom of the power curve.

notes.title: Terrain Hotfix & Automatic Trim Change
notes.notes:
This hot fix release includes:
[list]
[*]Fixed the 'Season 1' terrain problems that occurred during the last release
[*]Changed the way the airplane's automatic pitch trim works.  Now the trim will adjust as the player adds stick inputs (nose up/down).  I think this is very intuitive and works better than the previous manual approach. 
[*]Changed the player death "Respawn" button to "Restart Map".  This was done to better align with the recent changes that limit how many times the player can respawn. 
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34798018/4a00d9444133127e1c9e62bcf720a849273711e6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch 0.9.5 November - Updated Airplane Dynamics & Head Tracking Support
notes.notes:
Updates:

[b]Dynamic Airplane Weight[/b]
[list]
[*] Pilot, cargo, and fuel all add-up to increase the airplane weight.  This will impact airplane performance and handling.  As fuel is used the airplane will get lighter.  This will be a factor when planning cargo missions - especially at higher elevations, where airplane performance is already diminished.
[/list]

[b]Flaps & Trim[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new trim and flap indicators to the airplane panel, so you can now see what they are set to.
[*] Totally changed the flap physics and added three settings (aka notches).  Clicking the flap button cycles through 0-40 degrees.
[/list]

[b]Cockpit Free-look[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed cockpit free-look button behavior so that player can toggle it on or off.  
[/list]

[b]Track IR - Head Tracking Support[/b]
Added head tracking support, for Natrual Point's TrackIR hardware, on the cockpit camera.  Currently, it is always enabled.  Don’t forget that F12 re-centers the camera.

[b]Enter/Exit Airplane[/b]
[list]
[*] Slight change to entering and exiting the airplane: you now need to look at the door handle for interaction. The door animation will open and then close after you’re in the airplane.
[/list]

Let me know what you think.  Drop your ideas and feedback in the discussions.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.5 Mike - New 'Big Mountains' Map and more!
notes.notes:
Summer is over and it's time to get back to work on Groundfall! ːsteamhappyː  

My primary focus in upcoming patches will be around:
[list]
[*] Missions - add more engaging missions that are fun and reward the player with loot, airplane mods, etc.  Including more complex missions, different mission types and different mission providers (e.g. NPCs).
[*] Airplane -  flight characteristics, flaps and trim indicators, upgrades and modifications.
[*] Maps - different terrain styles and biomes and more points of interest to explore.
[*] Core Functionality - removing bugs and getting the existing systems working better.
[/list]


====================================================
This patch includes the following (and lots of small improvements) -

Additions:
[list]
[*]     New missions: a few new missions with more on the way.
[*]     New "Big Mountains" map: Unlock this map by landing at all the runways in the Training and Groundfall National Forest maps.
[*]     Added a runways completed HUD indicator when inside the airplane.   This shows the number of runways landed out of the total (e.g. 4/15).
[*]     Added new stilt-cabins located on beaches in the Big Mountains map.
[*]     Dynamic Windsocks:  direction and speed effect the windsock direction and animations.  Wind does not yet affect the airplane, but it will soon.
[/list]
    ‌

Updates:
[list]
[*]     Save system: completed landing objectives and side missions are now saved with other game data.  Also, updated the UI.  Note: there are still some save bugs (e.g. don't try to save while inside the airplane) that I will continue to work on.
[*]     Mission/objective UI now consistent with existing style.
[*]     Changed HUD markers colors for airstrips.  Red=not landed, Grey=landed, Green=next objective.
[*]     Changed HUD map to remain stationary while the player/airplane marker moves.
[*]     Disabled multi-player until further notice.  Several bugs had caused it to be almost un-playable.
[*]     Cabin are mostly located near the runways, but not all runways have a cabin.
[/list]

Bugs Fixes:
[list]
[*]     Wrong mini-map image in Training map.
[*]     Increased player look rotation speed.
[*]     Bent prop effect when damaging propeller.
[/list]

‌

notes.title: Patch 0.9.5k - Wheel Friction Bug Fix
notes.notes: A small fix to make the wheel friction less grippy on the snow.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.5k - Slippery Tires, Puddles, and More
notes.notes:
Hi all!  
Added a couple fun new features and fixed some small,  but significant, bugs.   

The new Airplane Inspection user interface is now working for repairing and refueling the airplane.  Its pretty simple right now, but it will be expanded and improved to include other consumables (e.g. oil) as well as other aircraft component modifications and upgrades.  

At some point, I unknowingly broken a couple key features - airplane repairs and tire surface friction!  Both are now fixed so you can slip on wet ground, bend your airplane, repair the damage, and do it all over again!  ːsteamthumbsupː


[list]
[*]New - Airplane Inspection UI - used for repairing and re-fueling the airplane. To use: move your player to the front of the airplane and look at the nose/engine to display the inspection prompt.  Additional airplane modifications using this same system are currently in development. 
[*]New Terrain Surface Condition - water puddles that can be slippery, making it difficult to slow/stop airplane.
[*]Fixed - some big rocks were culling too soon, causing them to vanish from the edge of the screen
[*]Fixed - load game from main menu not working
[*]Fixed - airplane wheel friction for different terrain surfaces
[*]Fixed - repairing aircraft not restoring flight dynamics correctly
[/list]
    
Enjoy and let me know what you think!

-Snow Creature

notes.title: Patch 0.9.5j - Big Rocks Quick Fix
notes.notes: Fixed the color/lighting issue that was causing distance rocks to appear darker.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.5j - Big Rocks
notes.notes:
Hi all!  
This patch has some fun new features and improvements:
[list]
[*]New: Airstrip Missions Manager - read signs to get current and next airstrip objective information and fly-over previews. POI objectives in development.
[*]New: Big Rocks - big rock biome for some airstrips. More biomes in development (e.g. stumps, logs, small rocks, puddles, etc.
[*]New: game mechanic that uses Morse code emergency locator radio signal for Search and Rescue (SAR) missions. As you fly closer to a transmitter, the SOS signal becomes clearer and louder.
[*]Changed: decreased default input sensitivity for mouse and joysticks. ATTENTION: Requires users to reset their player preferences.
[*]Changed: decreased the re-spawn timer
[*]Improved: made the rain FX and raindrop splashes more visible
[*]Improved: the volumetric cloud lighting color is now set to match the sun light color.
[/list]

...more good stuff on the way!

Note: I just noticed some color popping on the big rocks...researching problem and possible fix.

ATTENTION: I recently learned that that you have to clear your player preferences to see the controller changes I've been making.  I'll have more information on this soon.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.5g - Reduced Excessive Nose-Up Pitching
notes.notes:
Made some changes to the core flight physics to further minimize excessive nose-up pitching.  These changes are more fundamental and hopefully more effective than what I tried in the past.  The airplane now stays in a more neutral attitude at all speeds. 

Enjoy and let me know what you think!

notes.title: Patch 0.9.5h - Volumetric Clouds
notes.notes:
This is the first update of 2023 and now that the holiday chaos is behind me, I will return to a more frequent schedule for releasing patches.
 
This is a small patch, but it contains a big new feature in volumetric clouds that you can fly through.  This adds a new level of visual immersion to the game and makes flying more of a challenge when the weather gets bad.  More weather related challenges and effects are planned for upcoming release.

Enjoy!

--------

Added:
- Build Outpost mission - player builds a runway at specified outpost location for a Steam Achievement
- Volumetric Clouds - can create additional visibility challenge when flying in bad weather.  Water/rain effect on windshield when flying through clouds.
- New lightning strike effect during storms.

Fixed:
- Player death from survival status while inside airplane, not re-spawning correctly

notes.title: GroundFall - Patch 0.9.5g
notes.notes:
This patch contains some significant changes to airplane handling - both on the ground and in the air.   

Fixed:
- Airplane Brakes: made some changes to the airplane's center of gravity (CG) and adjusted the brake torque. The airplane is significantly less prone to nose-over when braking hard.
-Load Saved Game: eliminated duplicate airplane when loading saved game.
-Throttle: throttle-down input was instantly jumping to zero instead of incrementally decreasing.
-Airplane Tachometer Gauge (RPMs): wasn't working correctly...fixed and replaced instrument model.

Added:
- Pilot model for non-cockpit camera views. Only visible when using external camera modes.

Changed:
- Airplane Ignition/Start Time: reduced the amount of cranking time required to start engine.
- Airplane Tailwheel Suspension: decreased springiness to reduce tail bounce
- Decreased sensitivity range for mouse and joystick inputs.
- Re-worked the mouse input setup to improve flying with mouse... should be smoother.
- Shadows: smoother shadows that don't jitter as much.
- Flap Effect: moved lifting position aft

notes.title: GroundFall - Patch 0.9.5f1
notes.notes:

- Fuel and toolbox inventory stacking

Added:
- Sensitivity Mouse and Joystick settings for Pitch & Roll

notes.title: GroundFall - Patch 0.9.5f

notes.title: GroundFall - Patch 0.9.5e1

notes.title: Feature Update - Input binding & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
This update includes basic input/key re-binding for the flight controls and some bug fixes.  

[list]
[*]Added - Input Rebinding: You can now access the 'Controls' UI from the main menu, or the pause menu and re-bind inputs to your liking. 
[*]Fixed - UI Cursor/Pointer: total re-design of the moue/gamepad UI pointer for in-game menus.  It should now transition between mouse and gamepads smoothly and work properly with the inventory menu.  
[*]Fixed - Mission UI Lock: screen wasn't locking when accessing the mission radio wieldable and would sometimes prevent user from accessing other wieldables.
[/list]

Sorry for the delay on this patch!  I ran into several annoying issues while re-tooling the menus and trying to get everything working properly.  Hopefully the next few patches will go more quickly as I'm going to focus on missions, points of interest, and some level content.

notes.title: Update Notes - 9/29/22
notes.notes:
This is the first pass at fixing and improving some of the input issues.  More to come soon...

[list]
[*]Fixed - Main Menu: Controllers Blocking Keyboard Access: main menu should now switch between input devices and keyboard to allow keyboard access
[*]Added - New Flight Input System: completely replaced existing flight input system to allow for better device support and improved keyboard & mouse flying.  
[*] Added - Player flashlight/headlamp (toggle with L key, or left joystick button)
[*] Added - Airplane landing and cockpit lights (toggle with L key or left joystick button)
[*] Improved - New Airplane Braking:  braking now uses a single button to apply both brakes (right and left wheels) and relies on rudder input for differential braking - e.g. if brakes are applied and right rudder is applied the right brake will engage.
[*] Improved - airplane pitch trim system (including mouse wheel trim).  Be sure to adjust trim during takeoff roll.
[/list]

Next Up: 
[list]
[*] Input - More improvements to input and controller support [b]including rebinding[/b]
[*] Game Settings Menu
[*] More Missions
[*] Time and Weather Based Events
[*] Trim position indicator
[/list]
